title: Homosassa Springs Marina
specs: Rental boats have 75 HP Suzuki engines replaced every 3 years
Swim with manatees in the Springs about 15 minutes by boat
Scallop season from July through summer with thousands of boats
High-and-dry boat storage with quick launch and rinse service
Saltwater fishing license required for scalloping
Ability to swim to bottom of 4-6 foot deep water for scalloping
Pontoon boats hold 6, 10, or 12 people depending on size

options.name: Break In Service
options.detail: Service after initial break in period (usually 20 hours) to change fluids and check tolerances

options.name: Diagnosis and Repair
options.detail: Engine and electrical problem diagnosis and repair on time and materials basis

options.name: Analyze Engine
options.detail: Compression and leak down tests, fuel pressure test, computer diagnostic, and written report

options.name: Replace Water Pump
options.detail: Remove lower unit, inspect drive shaft and water pump housing, replace impeller and/or gaskets

options.name: 100 Hour Service
options.detail: Service every 100 hours or once per year including oil/filter change, anodes check/replacement, fuel filters replacement, lower unit oil change, spark plugs check/replacement, mounting bolts tightenin

options.name: 300 Hour Service
options.detail: Service every 300 hours or 3 years including 100 hour service plus lower unit removal and water pump replacement

options.name: Pontoon Boat Rentals
options.detail: Rental pontoon boats powered by Suzuki 75 HP outboard motors in three sizes: 20 ft (6 people), 22 ft (10 people), 24 ft (12 people)

blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats of various sizes to cruise the Homosassa River, swim with manatees, scallop in the Gulf, or fish. The marina offers high-and-dry boat storage with monthly pricing by boat length and specialty slip fees. They provide outboard engine repair, preventative maintenance, warranty repairs, and installation of accessories and new engines.
